title: It won't stop
story: You tested `train_loop.py` outside Slurm and left it running. It catches the polite stop signal that plain `kill` sends, prints nothing, and carries on. Find it and make sure it is really gone. (Plain `ps` won't list it, because you started it from a terminal you have since closed.)

tasks.text: Find the PID of train_loop.py and type it in the answer box

hints: `ps ux` (or `htop`) lists all of your processes. After `kill PID`, look again: if it is still listed, `kill -9 PID` forces it.
